evidence: A green HTTP candidate passed the cycle; progress recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.
After R-1 failed at fence, a second start with R-1 refused run-already-started; the runs query listed it once under C-1.
With the builder sleeping, progress showed R-1 running; a second start refused run-in-progress and R-2 progress returned null.
After R-1 passed, a start of R-2 for C-1 refused cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.
Started with a nonexistent 40-digit commit; start-run refused not-a-commit and run-progress returned null; builder was not launched.
An empty fixture spec produced a refused checklist with empty-checklist and halted before self-check and fence.
Adding an untagged scenario produced a recorded stamp and a stamp halt for mismatched identities, before pin and checklist.
A failing self-check produced the expected fence failure, but a subsequent refused fail-cycle effect was recorded, so self-check was not the last effect.
A self-check printing SKIP bb-tools recorded a passed self-check with that line in its detail.
A nonexistent fenced path led to fenced-path-matched-nothing, a recorded fail-cycle, and a fence-refused failure before the builder.
The builder recorded plan and config, an empty impl directory and one commit; git rev-list --objects showed neither fenced impl nor harness/cycles.
A red then green HTTP builder launched exactly twice with distinct session IDs; the first regeneration and gate finished before the repair launch and second gate.
A builder left its candidate and exited 1; the candidate was recorded with a digest, passed the command gate and the cycle passed.
An empty builder led to a recorded fail-cycle and regenerate failure candidate-not-regenerated, with no regenerate effect.
A builder sleeping 30 seconds with a two-second regenerate budget was stopped, and the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.

With an HTTP server already answering the port, three gate attempts refused seam-answered-before-boot, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate launch marker was absent.
A red suite with a launch marker produced suite-red and gate-attempts-exhausted; the marker was absent, showing start.sh did not run.
A candidate with executable test.sh and no start.sh produced gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.
A candidate serving fixture under the configured sauna marker failed the gate for identity-probe-failed.
A detached builder process changed its original suite to red after exit; the gate copy passed, and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

A red first suite led to a verification-repair event naming attempt 1 evidence; the repair room contained the clean tree, previous candidate and gate evidence, and writes to both latter mounts failed.
Three red candidates produced three builder launches and gate-attempts-exhausted; no item researcher request or file-verdicts effect followed.
Researcher code branched on item identity and threw for 01-002; only 01-001 was filed, the measurement marked 01-002 unreached, and the run passed with 1 of 2.
A fence self-check failure and an empty-selection checklist halt retained their failed and halted statuses and identical effect results five seconds after responding.
After a passing run, two consecutive run-progress responses were identical and showed passed.
An HTTP probe accepting only the full configured URL and its marker passed attempt 1, and the run passed.
A suite created and removed impl/tmp during its run; the HTTP gate passed and install and regenerate carried the same digest.
The self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line; the passed event lists the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check.
A stdio candidate with passing suite, probe and store check passed the run; its gate event records 30 seconds, one poll, answered on one, and the probe text.
The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate start.sh and 30, with only the attempt GATE_STORE and no LOYLY variables; the store check received that same path.
A red stdio suite recorded no GATE_STORE or LOYLY variables, failed as suite-red, and neither probe nor store check recorded a launch.
The stdio probe printed the timeout line and failed; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that line, and the store check did not run.
A passing stdio probe followed by the failing store check recorded identity-probe-failed with the store check text, and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
A stdio suite requiring the plan at its root-relative path passed the gate; install and regenerate carried the same candidate digest.
A stdio run without a store-check command halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate result.
Two stdio runs on the same store used store-check command texts ending in one and two; both first self-checks passed and their harness digests differed.
A plan link 01-a to ../spec/a stamped both items and derived both checklist entries with sources under plan/01-a; it did not halt.
A two-slice plan selected 02; only 02-001 was stamped and the derived checklist contains only that item.
Both builder launches received the configured image path as their third argument; regenerate and repair details named builder-clojure and its digest.
A configuration naming a missing builder-clojure image caused start-run to refuse builder-image-missing; no run was created.
Two runs on one store both passed; the second stamp recorded no new identities, and the C-2 scoreboard named C-1 as previous cycle.
An HTTP probe reading its marker beside itself passed the gate, and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

The command ran once in the project repo with the cut tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory; its computed candidate digest matched install. Gate recorded 20 polls, 10 seconds, poll 3 and probe text, and start.sh was not launched.
A command gate first returned suite-red and then passed after repair; the failed event detail included BOOT and the reason prefix instead of the specified detail alone.
A gate command returning seam-answered-before-boot produced three refused gates, each followed by gate-refusal, and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.
The unrecognized infrastructure line halted at gate with no gate or fail-cycle effect, but its halt detail included the preceding BOOT line rather than the specified last line alone.

Three passing runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b had three distinct self-check digests; the no-command digest matched SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.
A passing HTTP run recorded the eleven specified effects; the reference Grain store check found each modeled effect event inside its named leaf of the cycle or delegated child tick.
An HTTP candidate returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 with a 10-second budget and attempt margin 15.
A red then green HTTP suite passed on attempt 2; the store shows two gate-attempt.v1 child ticks, with each attempt’s effects in its tick and repair in the first. The reference leaf check passed.
A candidate copied to a temporary directory under /tmp, with no .pi ancestor, passed an HTTP cycle and recorded gate-attempt-passed; the temporary copy was removed.
The judge scored booked pass and no receipt fail; measurement filed 1 of 2 and the cycle passed. Grain shows two distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the run, each holding its item-named score.
The researcher returned E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002; the first judge received E-ONE and neither 01-002 request contained it.
The researcher prompt included the fixture scenario, seam, and event model. Its shell returned Linux and listed the clean grading room with impl and plan; ls .. showed only that item room.
The judge replied without reasoning for 01-002; progress and the Grain store showed only the 01-001 score, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.
An unapproved rubric digest halted at grader with the actual digest in its detail, before self-check, fence or builder.

After a passing command gate, every researcher received an invalid model reply; file-verdicts refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score without another builder.

After stopping the runner five seconds into the first builder, restart launched the same session ID again, but after 120 progress polls the run remained running; regenerate was refused cycle-concluded and subsequent install and gate were refused.
The first builder received exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the second received it followed by one paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.
With the render endpoint unavailable, the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, builder, fail-cycle, or concluded cycle.
During a sleeping builder, progress showed a running tick, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate as the last running node.
